_note: OKF-style knowledge map of the BuildOS platform. Drives /playground. Types: application, service, datastore, concept.

nodes.label: BuildOS Platform
nodes.info: AI engineering platform: three products forming one agentic development loop.

nodes.label: BuildOS Agent
nodes.info: Persistent workspace for planning, multi-agent coordination, and AI-assisted coding.

nodes.label: Knowledge Hub
nodes.info: Parses repositories into structured OKF engineering knowledge for AI agents.

nodes.label: Node Commander
nodes.info: Agentless SSH fleet management: Docker ops, migrations, terminal access.

nodes.label: OKF Graph
nodes.info: Open Knowledge Format — deterministic structural map of apps, APIs, and schemas.

nodes.label: Tree-sitter Parser
nodes.info: Multi-language AST extraction: classes, functions, calls, dependencies.

nodes.label: Metadata Harvester
nodes.info: Extracts structure from OpenAPI specs and live database schemas.

nodes.label: AI Broker / Router
nodes.info: Routes tasks across Claude, Gemini, Groq, and Ollama by latency and depth.

nodes.label: Agent Planner
nodes.info: Breaks feature requests into stateful sub-tasks for specialized agents.

nodes.label: State Verifier
nodes.info: Circuit breaker: halts agent loops after repeated failures, requests human review.

nodes.label: Context Builder
nodes.info: Pre-compiles schemas, dependencies, and constraints before LLM dispatch.

nodes.label: Migration Relay
nodes.info: Secure transfer bridge for zero-downtime docker-compose migrations.

nodes.label: SSH Streamer
nodes.info: Paramiko-based agentless command streaming and browser terminal.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.info: Relational state, execution logs, and OKF graph boundaries.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.info: Job queues, locking, and rate limiting for event-driven execution.

nodes.label: Vector Index
nodes.info: pgvector/Qdrant semantic index paired with the relational graph.

nodes.label: Docker Fleet
nodes.info: Self-hosted fleet: 20+ services behind Cloudflare tunnels.
